includes: Roof sheeting: Lysaght Custom Orb (RF:01) on both houses at 5°, and Lysaght Trimdek (RF:03) on both carport bays at 3°.
Every roof edge: gutter, high side, barge and wall junction, as plan and true lengths.
Insulation under the Custom Orb: Anticon 60 mm R1.6 faced blanket with spacers (A2100), the same area as the house roofs.
questions: Which stages does this quote cover? The drawings put House 2 and both carport bays in Stage 1 (A1000A), and House 1 in Stage 2 (A1001A).
Are the Colorbond gutters and 100 × 100 downpipes (Pearl White, RF:02) part of the roofing package?
The drawings give no colour for the Custom Orb or the Trimdek.
The carport roof length isn't dimensioned. It scales to 5.60 m on the 1:100 site plan. Confirm it before ordering.
No vents, flues or exhaust fans are shown on either house roof. Confirm there are none.
